prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Discord Developer Needed to Help Set Up New Member Onboarding Experience and Bot Automation
We have a small Discord community (~70 members) that we am looking to expand, but before doing so we want to have a good new member onboarding experience set up like most of the "big" Discord communities have. Our community is called "CIRSMap Community" and it is a health and wellness related community. We have 30+ channels for all different topics. We do not have a large budget as this community does not yet make any money, but what we need right now is pretty straightforward and as we grow we will need more improvements made and bots further customized for a richer member experience. The server owner Justin will be the point of contact and is technically-minded as well as a copywriter and can provide clean and concise instructions and guidance on what we need. It would also be a plus if the developer can provide some ideas for how we can improve our server beyond the ideas that we currently have (as we are fairly new to running a Discord community). Right now we are set up with our own CIRSMap bot (doesn't do anything at the moment), Zapier bot, and LaunchPass bot (for when we eventually monetize the server. We would prefer not to have to use MEE6 due to some things that have recently come to light with their questionable NFT/crypto activities, but if there's no other way then we would be ok with it. Tasks: - Setup process where new members join and are required to agree to Community Rules before being admitted to the other channels. OpenAI has a nice process to model after
</job>

text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help CIRSMap Community create a smooth new-member onboarding experience and practical bot automation.

I have extensive experience building AI-driven assistants and workflow tools in Python. For Parcelwise Logistics, I built a WhatsApp and SMS delivery support chatbot that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context, with 43% of conversations resolved without an agent. I also built a contract clause search assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and quotes the exact clause and page used, with faithfulness of 0.91 on a lawyer-written test set.

For your Discord server, I can set up a clean rules-agreement onboarding flow, help organize access to channels, and suggest sensible improvements as the community grows. I’m comfortable working with OpenAI API, LangChain, Python, and related automation tools, and I’d be glad to collaborate closely with Justin’s instructions.
